svg.text: Learned parameters: 32 × 4 × 19 + 32 = 2464 in the filters, 33 in the dense layer: 2497 in total.
Logistic regression (Machine learning from scratch) uses features you choose (GC, motif counts);
the CNN learns its features, the filters, together with the logistic-regression weights.
Same model, more layers: everything left of the dense layer is a feature extractor.
